ABOUT US
BTC Europe GmbH is a wholly owned subsidiary of BASF. Learn more about BTC Europe GmbH at on.basf.com/BTCEurope/EN

WELCOME TO BASF
As a European distribution organization of the BASF Group, BTC Europe sells highly-refined specialty and fine chemicals to international customers in numerous industries. We capitalize on our proximity to our customers, agility, many years of expertise and the accumulated know-how of the BASF Verbund.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
The Account Manager establishes and develops profitable customer relationships, achieves revenue as well as margin targets, and identifies growth opportunities. As primary customer contact, he/she coordinates internal resources, negotiates contractual terms, and ensures target achievement through regular reporting. The Account Manager lives the BTC PACE values and works in line with local law, BASF compliance guidelines, and business-critical processes (e.g. PULs).

- You develop and execute account plans in line with the overall strategy, actively drive new business, and leverage cross-selling opportunities.
- Analyzing market and competitor trends, translating insights into growth opportunities, and supporting the launch of new products and applications is part of your responsibilities.
- You manage your customer portfolio with a focus on growth and financial targets, build strong relationships with key stakeholders, and ensure transparent documentation in Salesforce.
- In addition, you take ownership of price management, promote the full portfolio, and lead customer negotiations.
- As a central interface, you coordinate internal and external stakeholders, ensure smooth customer-facing processes, and collaborate closely with local and European teams while contributing to digitalization and continuously developing your expertise.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- master's degree in business or life science
- professional experience in relevant application technologies and industry know-how
- several years of professional experience in application technology or in sales of products for the cosmetics industry
- strong knowledge in contract negotiations, account planning, and customer relationship management, ideally with Salesforce experience
- fluent German and advanced English skills, plus confident use of IT tools and MS Office applications
- proactive team player with excellent communication skills, intercultural competence, and a growth-driven mindset
- willingness to travel, mainly in Germany

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% home office
- company car
- inspiring networks for developing and implementing your own ideas (e.g., Women in Business)
- mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development
- career paths for professional growth, including opportunities to move into other roles within the company
- 30 vacation days, plus options for special leave and sabbatical models
- flexible working time arrangements (e.g., part-time employment)
- an attractive salary, based on business success and your individual performance
- bicycle leasing options

jobs.description:
ABOUT US
BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you'll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine‑Neckar metropolitan region. You can learn more about the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof here.
Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here
Diversity is our greatest strength!
Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
WELCOME TO BASF
We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture.
#ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice
Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions!
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing for a partial IPO. Therefore, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: build your career on our Standalone Transformation).

- In your new position, you lead and execute national and international real estate transactions across the EMEA region, including acquisitions, disposals, lease negotiations, lettings, and property valuations, while ensuring full alignment with the corporate real estate strategy.
- Together with your colleagues, you manage and coordinate cross-regional real estate projects with a strong focus on headquarters requirements, overseeing implementation and steering external consultants, brokers, property managers, and additional service providers.
- Furthermore, you negotiate commercial, lease, purchase, and service agreements, conduct in-depth financial analyses and property valuations, and prepare high-quality decision papers and recommendations for senior management based on established methodologies.
- Your expertise is in demand! You ensure high-quality real estate data management, maintain accurate reporting and portfolio documentation, monitor relevant KPIs, and contribute to compliance with internal governance standards.
- Not least, you support the continuous development and optimization of the corporate real estate portfolio by identifying value-creation opportunities and contributing to long-term occupancy, investment, and workplace strategies, including modern office concepts.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- completed Master's degree in real estate management or a related field; alternatively, a bachelor's degree in engineering or business administration with additional real estate qualifications
- at least 7 years of relevant professional experience in corporate or commercial real estate, asset management, transactions, or capital projects in an international environment
- strong expertise in real estate transactions, portfolio management, property valuation, financial analysis, lease administration, contract negotiations, and project management
- fluent German and English skills, additional european languages are a plus, combined with solid experience in sap (e.g. sap re-fx, sap fi/co) and Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint
- strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, paired with excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation skills, and a proactive, solution-oriented as well as structured working style

WHAT WE OFFER

- A unique opportunity to shape a pivotal function within a company that prepares for the IPO.
- A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility.
- A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation.
- Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business).
- Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development.
- Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company.
- We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health.
- We offer sustainable mobility benefits — a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly.

HOW TO REACH US

- Lennart Boudgoust (Talent Acquisition), lennart.boudgoust@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56521 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online. Technical questions cannot be answered at this meeting.

jobs.description:
#ONEr2p

Are you ready for something new, solution-oriented and keen to work in a future-oriented and sustainable industry that is driven by innovation and the latest technologies? Then look no further! 
We are currently looking for a Team Lead Project Management and Engineering (m/f/d) to lead our German Project and Engineering Team at our HQ located in Flensburg!

This is how You Make a Difference

As Team Lead Project Management and Engineering (m/f/d) you will be responsible for leading and overseeing the delivery of all projects within the entity as well as managing our German Project Management and Project Engineering Teams. Your tasks will include:

- Ensuring targets for time, cost, quality, and margin are achieved. 
- Acting as the primary escalation point for critical or underperforming projects, defining and driving recovery actions.
- Ensuring accurate project forecasting, including EAC/ETC, cash flow, and milestone commitments.
- Enforcing global project management standards, governance, and gate processes consistently at BU level.
- Managing and developing the project management and engineering organization locally, including coaching and performance management.
- Reviewing and challenging project plans, risks, schedules, and commercial assumptions throughout the lifecycle.
- Safeguarding project profitability through disciplined change management and contract compliance.
- Leading customer and internal steering meetings, supporting escalation management and key decision‑making.
- Ensuring high‑quality project reporting and data accuracy for global portfolio and management reporting.
- Providing structured feedback and improvement proposals to the Global Head of Project Management based on BU experience.

You are

- effective in managing stakeholders and customers, including steering committees and escalation handling.
- able to lead and recover complex or troubled projects, applying structured recovery and escalation plans.
- a strong people leader and coach, with proven experience in developing, guiding, and performance-managing project managers, engineers, and support roles.
- someone with a strong risk management and issue resolution mindset, with proactive identification and mitigation of delivery and commercial risks.
- clear and structured when communicating and able to provide reliable project status, forecasts, and escalations to global management.

What you Bring to the Table

- A university degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with a solid foundation in project delivery, commercial management, and project economics.
- 6+ years in project delivery with 2+ years leading PM teams, delivering complex multi‑disciplinary projects (€2–20M+) and recovering troubled projects.
- Strong commercial and financial control (contracts, change/claims, EAC/ETC, cash), proven governance enforcement, and experience with customer steering, supplier management, and handover to service.
- Proven expertise in end‑to‑end project delivery, ensuring time, cost, quality, and margin objectives are met.
- Solid knowledge of project planning and control techniques (critical path, milestone trend analysis, risk & dependency management).
- Experience applying and enforcing global PM governance frameworks, standards, and gate processes at BU level.
- Competence with project management tools and reporting (e.g. MS Project, Power BI consumption, portfolio dashboards) and data accuracy discipline.
- Experience with MS Project/Power BI/Teams and building PM capability.
- A fluency in German and English.

Also an advantage:

- PM certifications.
- Sector experience with regulated/safety‑critical environments.

Your Benefits

- A comprehensive onboarding phase.
- Entry into an innovative and future-oriented industry.
- Flat hierarchies and an open-door philosophy.
- Flexible working time models and a 37-hour week.
- Hybrid working up to two days a week.
- Ergonomic workplace equipment.
- E-bike leasing for you and your partner.
- An offer portal (corporate benefits) with discount codes for numerous brands from all areas of life.
- An annual health budget that can be used for many different services, including visual aids, prescription medication and professional teeth cleaning.

Interested?

Please send us your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations to jobs@r2p.com or click on the link Team Lead Project Management and Engineering (m/w/d) | Jobs at r2p Group (https://r2p-group.jobs.personio.de/job/2586566?apply) .

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Global Procurement Process Manager (P2P) (f/m/d), you drive the continuous transformation, harmonization, and governance of global end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay processes across regions, functions, and business units. You collaborate closely with Procurement, Finance, Engineering, and IT teams to design and implement a standardized SAP S/4HANA-based process landscape while advancing strategic transformation initiatives. By leveraging digital technologies such as AI and process mining tools, you identify optimization opportunities, enhance process efficiency, and support the deployment of innovative solutions. Through active stakeholder engagement, performance monitoring, training, and best-practice sharing, you ensure sustainable adoption, continuous improvement, and global alignment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Ownership and continuous development of the global end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process landscape for Direct and Indirect Materials, including process harmonization, standardization, and governance across regions and business units.
* Design, implementation, and monitoring of governance frameworks, compliance standards, and internal control mechanisms to ensure process integrity and regulatory adherence.
* Leadership of global cross-functional transformation initiatives in collaboration with Procurement, Finance, Engineering, and IT stakeholders.
* Optimization and strategic enhancement of procurement systems, particularly SAP S/4HANA, in alignment with the global process and system template.
* Identification and realization of efficiency and automation opportunities through digital technologies, including AI solutions and process mining tools such as Celonis and Signavio, as well as implementation of innovative P2P solutions.
* Performance management, senior stakeholder engagement, best-practice sharing, benchmarking activities, and delivery of training and change communication programs to support organizational transformation.

What You Bring

* University degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Extensive professional experience in global Procurement with a strong focus on end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process management for direct and/or indirect materials.
* Proven track record in leading large-scale process transformation and optimization initiatives within complex international organizations.
* Advanced expertise in SAP S/4HANA, AI-enabled procurement solutions, process mining tools (e.g., Celonis, Signavio), and P2P process optimization.
* Strong capabilities in cross-functional project leadership, governance and compliance management, KPI-driven performance management, stakeholder engagement, change management, and strategic problem-solving.
* Business-fluent German and English language skills.

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Join our team in Bonn as Change Manager, starting as soon as possible (fixed-term position for 1 year)

The Finance Systems Transformation Team is responsible for running the SHAPE+ program - a DHL Group wide cross-divisional Finance transformation program. SHAPE+ aims at driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes across Business Units and its consolidation into ONE SAP S/4HANA Finance ERP platform. This will significantly increase the efficiency and effectiveness of our Finance set-up and is the necessary basis for the continuous transformation and digitalization of the DHL Group’s Finance organization globally.

As Change Manager within the Change, Communication and Training (CCT) Academy, you as discipline owner for Change Management will be responsible for defining and executing change activities to enable change in close collaboration with the Senior Management to make the transformation as smooth as possible. In addition, you will be supporting the CCT Academy Team in realizing communications and training activities.

 

As an agile working team, the CCT Academy ensures that the rollout teams are always up to speed and end users are well prepared for the SHAPE+ rollout of the new processes and platform. We act as one CCT Academy team acknowledging the close connection of Change, Communication and Training activities. We all have our clear focus areas according to our expertise but realize our CCT vision jointly supporting each other in all CCT areas. 

 

Your tasks

 
* Ensure professional and efficient change management during the SHAPE+ deployment, for larger releases, enabling a successful system/release implementation and user adoption
* Own and maintain the approach for all activities related to Change Management and application enablement and governance
* Proactively identify change needs, define actions, execute, track and report on all change measures
* Accountable for the overall change execution and implementation assurance
* Develop change agility and resilience amongst the SHAPE+ community
* Steer divisional teams throughout the different program phases and ensure that the divisional teams realize the agreed change management activities also on an entity level
* Collaborate with our divisional rollout teams to ensure alignment of change, communications and training needs across all entities involved
* Support the divisions in successfully leading change, e.g. with Leading Change Workshop and train-the-trainer module
* Support the successful end-user adoption of new processes and tools e.g. by the use of Digital Adoption Tools, application of UX principles and End-User-Surveys

 

Your profile

 
* Passionate Change Manager with the ability to influence and motivate teams
* Experienced in enabling employees to adapt to change and implement it successfully
* Open minded with a can-do attitude and persistence, comfortable in a fast-moving, fluid, international environment
* Execution mindset and strong desire to consistently generate tangible outputs and value
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, moderate difficult discussions, and deliver presentations effectively, addressing diverse seniority levels
* Min. 3 years of experience with Digital Adoption Tool knowledge, e.g. WalkMe, Oracle Guided Learning, SAP companion 
* Proficient English and German skills are a must have (verbal and written)
* Strong organizational skills and thorough experience in project management
* Min. 4 years work experience in the area of Change Management or similar disciplines
* Experience within the DHL Group, Finance or SAP FI/CO process knowledge is a plus

 

Your benefits

 
* Competitive compensation package with 20% variable part
* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision
* Salary conversion for environmentally friendly commuting, leasing of company bicycle or lease of electric company car. Alternatively conventional vehicles are available, too 
* Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities
* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities
* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays
* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies
* Collaborate with executives and senior management in the global finance community, contributing to strategic decision-making processes and become a game changer in the largest Finance transformation in the industry
* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.
* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers

 

Your contact

Please contact Hannah Braselmann, Head of Change Management, Communication and Training Academy, for further information: hannah.braselmann@dhl.com

We are looking forward to your application.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as a Risk Manager (Nuclear New Build - NNB) based in Germany (Erlangen or Mülheim an der Ruhr), where you will support the risk evaluation and the failures prevention across complex products and projects in the nuclear environment. You will operate across the full lifecycle—from product development interfaces to early opportunity shaping and bid readiness to project execution—ensuring risk management is consistently applied in line with our standards and with a nuclear standards and regulations. In this role, you help teams ensure risks transparency, enable robust decisions, and support the portfolio and project objectives.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* You will understand customer requirements and help ensure projects and the portfolio address the risks linked to meeting those objectives.
* Partner with risk owners to maintain and improve risk management plans that are practical, current, and aligned with process instructions.

Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

As Project Director, you carry overall accountability for the successful delivery of strategically critical Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication (EPF) projects in the field of alkaline water electrolysis or chlor alkaline electrolysis . You lead at executive level with ownership to deliver complex projects covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning on schedule, at cost and at quality. The role requires business judgement, solution orientation, technical credibility and the ability to manage international teams, drive decisions and secure results in complex settings with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.
Your responsibilities will include:

- You hold end-to-end accountability for the full EPC project lifecycle, from bid support and handover into execution through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and final handover to the client
- You establish the project execution plan and own the interface to all internal and external executive level project stakeholders, in order to lead complex projects with clarity, speed and control
- You integrate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial management and contract administration into one integrated global, cross-functional and intercultural project team
- You challenge bid assumptions, execution concepts, schedule logic, partner models and resource plans before project start in order to secure realistic and executable baselines
- You own delivery performance against schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, quality and contractual commitments and intervene early where deviations threaten project outcomes
- You actively govern technical, commercial, contractual and interface risks and ensure that mitigation, recovery and decision measures are implemented with discipline
- You safeguard contractual entitlement through structured change management, claim strategy, escalation handling and robust decision documentation
- You act as the primary interface to project sponsors, steering committees, customer decision-makers and key external partners in critical project matters
- You are able to dive into technical problem solving when required, bring credible depth in at least one relevant technical field, and drive your execution team toward timely, robust and executable decisions
- You lead critical project situations with clear priorities, direct interventions and fact-based decisions, including phases of instability, recovery or major change
- You strengthen the project organization by guiding Project Managers and senior discipline leads and by setting a clear standard for execution discipline and accountability

Profil

- You have completed a degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline
- You have extensive experience of more than 10 years leading major EP / EPF / EPC(m) projects in the chemical or energy business with high technical, contractual and stakeholder complexity
- You have a proven track record of steering projects through difficult phases such as bid-to-execution transition, execution ramp-up, major contractual changes, recovery and in periods of significant delivery pressure
- You combine executive presence with delivery discipline and are able to lead large cross-functional and intercultural organizations without relying on disciplinary authority
- You bring strong command of project economics, including cost forecasting, margin protection, cash development, schedule impacts and recovery planning
- You understand how contract strategy, change management and claims affect project outcome and know how to steer these topics together with the commercial function
- You bring sufficient technical depth in at least one relevant field and are able to structure, challenge and steer engineering-driven solution development
- You make sound decisions under uncertainty and create clarity in situations with incomplete information, multiple interfaces and high stakeholder pressure
- You hold a recognized senior project management certification, such as PMP or an equivalent qualification
- You are fluent in English and preferably also German
- You are willing to undertake extensive international travel as required by the project and are prepared to accept extended assignments abroad when necessary

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal undamp; Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures

At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:

- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.

- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.
